message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout that lasted a few hours. I felt a little silly when I realized I was the only one in the neighborhood with a fully stocked stash of flashlights, lanterns, and power banks. While my family was busy fumbling for candles, I was happily setting up a cozy corner with snacks and games by lantern light. Sometimes being the gloriously over-prepared person pays off in unexpected ways! What’s your go-to comfort plan for power outages?
